Accepted Format: P + 9 digits + 3 letters/digits, e.g. P000012345aB3; the last 3 characters are case-sensitive
If Invalid: Row error MALFORMED_UNIQUE_ID; well formed but unknown: row error UNKNOWN_UNIQUE_ID
Notes: Same matching as the personnel file. The Provider must already exist (ingest the personnel file first) and have a Healthcare Provider record (otherwise PROVIDER_NOT_SET_UP). Providers are not limited to the roster's Organization.

Accepted Format: 10 digits with a valid NPI check digit
If Invalid: Row error MALFORMED_NPI; no Provider with this NPI: row error UNKNOWN_PROVIDER
Notes: Finds the Provider when no Unique ID is given. If Unique ID and NPI identify different Providers: MULTIPLE_MATCHES. If the Provider found by Unique ID has a different NPI: KEY_MISMATCH. At least one of the two Provider keys is required (otherwise NO_KEY_VALUES).

Accepted Format: MF + 9 digits + 3 letters/digits, e.g. MF000702523t0K; the last 3 characters are case-sensitive
If Invalid: Row error MALFORMED_FACILITY_UNIQUE_ID; well formed but unknown: row error UNKNOWN_FACILITY_UNIQUE_ID
Notes: When given, it decides the facility. A Facility NPI or address also given must agree with it (FACILITY_KEY_MISMATCH), unless the facility has none stored. The facility must belong to the roster's Organization scope (otherwise FACILITY_NOT_IN_ORGANIZATION, naming the facility's owner). Ignored on Terminate = All.

Accepted Format: 10 digits with a valid NPI check digit
Notes: Used when no Facility Unique ID is given: it must match exactly one facility in the roster's Organization scope (several: MULTIPLE_FACILITY_MATCHES; none: FACILITY_NOT_FOUND). Not unique in Salesforce: several facilities can share a group NPI. Ignored on Terminate = All.

Accepted Format: A single street line, e.g. 100 Main St
If Invalid: No facility in scope at this address: row error FACILITY_NOT_FOUND; several: MULTIPLE_FACILITY_MATCHES
Notes: Compared with the first line of the facility's Shipping Street, ignoring case, extra spaces and trailing punctuation; no abbreviation rules ('St' and 'Street' differ). Used to find the facility only when neither facility ID is given. When an ID is given, a different address is a row error FACILITY_KEY_MISMATCH (provisional; may become a warning). A facility with no stored address never matches by address. Ignored on Terminate = All.

When Written: Only when a relationship is created; never changes an existing one
Accepted Format: MM/DD/YYYY (leading zeros optional), any real date
If Invalid: Create row: row error INVALID_START_DATE (the relationship is not created). Terminate row: ignored
Notes: Terminate rows ignore it, with warning START_DATE_IGNORED. Create row for a relationship that already exists: not applied; warning START_DATE_DIFFERS when the stored date is different or blank.

Accepted Format: Blank = create the relationship; Single = terminate this Provider's relationship with this facility; All = terminate all this Provider's relationships at facilities of the roster's Organization scope (any case)
Notes: Terminate = All ignores the facility columns, with warning FACILITY_COLUMNS_IGNORED when any is filled in. See relationships-file-rules.txt for what each action does.
Each facility Account is assumed to have exactly one Healthcare Facility.

When Written: True when a relationship is created; false when it is terminated
Notes: The org's Provider Plan Participation flows react to this field: activating creates a plan participation, deactivating can end it.

Stored As: The date the ingestion run started
Notes: The file has no termination date column.

Salesforce Field Label: Account ID, Contact ID, Predecessor Record, Effective From, Effective To, Termination Reason
Notes: Decided not to set these (2026-10-18). A terminated relationship is never reactivated or linked to a new one.
